faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1_title: Is RemitBuddy a money transfer service?
faq.q1_desc: No. RemitBuddy compares exchange rates and fees from multiple providers. Actual transfers are made on the provider's website.
faq.q2_desc: Yes. It's 100% free and always will be. We never charge users for comparisons.
faq.q3_desc: We may receive a referral fee from providers when you use their service through our links. This doesn't affect the rates you see — we always show the actual rates from each provider, and our rankings are based purely on the amount your recipient receives.
faq.q4_title: How often is the exchange rate updated?
faq.q4_desc: We fetch live exchange rates directly from each provider every time you compare. Rates can change by the minute, so we always show the most current data available.
faq.q5_desc: You can compare transfers to 18 countries including Vietnam, Philippines, Nepal, Cambodia, Thailand, Indonesia, and more. We're adding new corridors regularly.

education.title: Understanding Remittance
education.subtitle: Make smarter decisions with these quick tips
education.tip1_desc: A great exchange rate can be offset by high fees. Always compare the total amount received, not just the rate.
education.tip2_desc: Rates fluctuate throughout the day. Major news events and market openings can cause significant swings.
education.tip3_desc: Faster transfers often cost more. If you can wait 1-2 days, you might get better rates.
education.tip4_desc: Some providers charge receiving bank fees or currency conversion fees. RemitBuddy shows the true total.
